# Linkker

> Linkker saves links from anywhere (Chrome, iPhone, Android), sorts them into smart AI categories and finds them in seconds. Private links can sit behind a PIN or biometrics, and links and files move between phone and computer over your own Wi-Fi.

## Pages
- [Home](https://linkker.space/): what Linkker does and where to get it
- [Support](https://linkker.space/support): help and contact
- [Blog](https://linkker.space/blog/): hand-picked free websites and AI tools

## Articles
Hand-picked lists of free websites and tools. Each page opens with quick picks, then one honest card per site.

- [11 best Chrome extensions for students, from research to deadlines](https://linkker.space/blog/best-chrome-extensions-for-students): Build a free study toolkit for planning assignments, finding papers, managing tabs, reviewing lectures, and proofreading, with each extension’s limits explained
- [8 free alternatives to Microsoft Word for documents, reports, and DOCX](https://linkker.space/blog/free-alternative-to-microsoft-word): Compare free word processors for offline writing, shared drafts, and editing Word files, with the account requirements and limitations explained.
- [6 free online tools to remove background from image files](https://linkker.space/blog/free-online-tool-to-remove-background-from-image): Make transparent PNGs with six browser tools, with clear explanations of resolution limits, commercial-use restrictions, and other catches.
- [The 8 best free AI video generators for clips, explainers, and talking](https://linkker.space/blog/best-free-ai-video-generator): Compare tools with ongoing free access, see which actually generate footage, and understand the limits before spending time on a video.
- [The 9 best free AI image generators](https://linkker.space/blog/best-free-ai-image-generator): Create illustrations, posters, backgrounds, and visual ideas with tools that offer ongoing free access, with clear notes on limits, privacy, and downloads.
- [The 8 best free AI tools for video editing](https://linkker.space/blog/best-ai-tools-for-video-editing-free): Find editors that actually let you finish a video for free, with clear details on captions, automatic cuts, watermarks, and export limits.
- [12 cool websites to visit when you want something better than scrolling](https://linkker.space/blog/cool-websites-to-visit): Make music, wander unfamiliar streets, explore space, and find small browser experiments worth saving, with free access and clear catches.
- [The 8 best free AI tools for video creation](https://linkker.space/blog/free-ai-tools-for-video-creation): Find useful video editors, AI presenters, and local video generators, with clear explanations of watermarks, usage caps, and hardware requirements.
- [11 useful websites for students that solve specific study problems](https://linkker.space/blog/useful-websites-for-students): Find free help with citations, confusing graphs, research papers, project visuals, and getting started on assignments—with each site's catch explained.
- [12 best free websites for portfolios](https://linkker.space/blog/best-free-websites-for-portfolios): Find a place to publish your work without paying, with clear explanations of each tool’s strengths, branding, publishing limits, and other catches.
